notes.title: Patch Notes - May 5th, 2025 (v1.3.5.2)
notes.content:
• Fixed an issue where the leaderboard displayed incorrectly the first time during special online levels.  
• Fixed a bug that caused incorrect leaderboard rankings under specific conditions after uploading a score in special online levels.  
• Fixed boundary issues and oversized checkpoints in some levels.  
• Removed the countdown timer display in special online levels.

By the way, the special level [b]Shuhei's Gauntlet[/b] is now live! Beat [i]Shuhei Yoshida[/i]’s record to unlock his exclusive outfit!

notes.title: Patch Notes - May 2nd, 2025 (v1.3.4.1)
notes.content:
• Adjusted several systems in online mode and added extra version checks for compatibility.
• Fixed checkpoint trigger ranges in certain levels.
• Fixed boundary issues in some levels.
• Fixed an issue where enabling Chronolag under specific conditions caused the game to run slowly.
• Fixed an issue where manually selected ghosts in online mode did not update correctly in certain situations.
• Fixed various joystick connection-related errors.

notes.title: Patch Notes - April 23th, 2025 (v1.3.3.3)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the unlocking condition check for the [b]Omega[/b] achievement could be skipped.
[*] Now, the game will check for the [b]Omega[/b] achievement upon launch to compensate for missed unlocks.
[*] Fixed a bug where resetting save data could cause issues with achievement tracking.
[*] We’ve identified that [b]DirectX 12[/b] may cause crashes on certain setups. This launch option has been temporarily disabled.
[*] Fixed boundary issues in some levels.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - April 22th, 2025 (v1.3.2.3)
notes.content:
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where deleting save data would reset progress toward achievements.
[*] Fixed various level boundary and camera issues.
[/list]
[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added [b]Advanced Controls[/b] in the option menu:
[list]
[*] Added a new [b]Spherical Gravity Controls[/b] setting, allowing players to choose between [b]Screen Space (default)[/b] or [b]Character Relative[/b] for movement direction control.
[/list]
[*] The [b]Large Hint Buttons[/b] option in [b]Advanced Graphics[/b] options now also scales the size of the ChronoLag timer display, enhancing visual clarity on handheld devices like the Steam Deck.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - April 18th, 2025 (v1.3.1.4)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added a "Report Bug" button in the pause menu, which opens a Google Form for reporting issues.
[*] Fixed an issue where controller keybindings were not saved (they would reset after restarting the game).
[*] Fixed several level issues that caused endless falling.
[*] Fixed a bug where the online mode displayed expired leaderboards in certain situations, causing errors.
[/list]

notes.title: Bionic Bay in Game Devs of Color Expo! (September 20th - September 30th)
notes.content:
[h2]Game Devs of Color Expo[/h2]
"Bionic Bay"  is participating in The 2023 Game Devs of Color Expo! 
Game Devs of Color Expo is amplifying the creative power held by people of different color in games. The event will take place from September 20th to September 30th (UTC+8). During the event, we will be offering a free demo version for play!

[b][h2]Live streaming[/h2][/b]
Additionally, we will be live streaming during the Color Expo event, where our developers will showcase gameplay of the demo version!

notes.title: Watch the time-limited live broadcast of Bionic Bay!
notes.content:
Bionic Bay is participating in The Nightmarket Festival 2022, and is showcasing a time-limited live broadcasts until Aug 8 10am PST!

The Nightmarket Festival 2022 is showcasing around 100 discounted games, and offering free demos for dozens of hot upcoming titles!

The sale runs from Aug 4-8 10am PST. And includes live broadcasts to celebrate and showcase the lineup. 

The Nightmarket Festival 2022 is the first-ever Steam sales event focusing on promoting games from the SEA region, breaking cultural barriers, and raising awareness for the region’s gaming scene. We introduce awesome games with a local touch, just like the night market culture commonly seen here -- filled with creativity, diversity, and great fun.

[h2]The Nightmarket Festival Live Show Program[/h2]

[h3]Aug 5-6 23:00 - 08:30 PST (in Mandarin)[/h3]
[b]Featured games[/b]: OPUS: Echo of Starsong - Full Bloom Edition, My Lovely Wife, Alina of the Arena, Potion Permit, SIMULACRA 3, Minds Beneath Us

[h3]Aug 6-7 23:00 - 01:30 PST (in English)[/h3]
[b]Featured games[/b]: Asterigos: Curse of the Stars, Dusk Diver 2, Nine Sols, Dungeon Munchies, The Legend of Tianding

Get your wallet ready and enjoy a diverse taste of unique SEA games waiting for you to check out! Forget the scorching weather, the party’s indoors! We got your weekend covered!
